title: Tabloid
summary: A Python application (in Russian) for generating and evaluating synthetic tabular data, offering a choice of Gaussian Copula, CTGAN, and TVAE model backends. It directly imports and calls SDV's single-table synthesizers and its evaluate_quality function to build and assess synthetic datasets.
evidence: core/synthesis.py:44-58 instantiates GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer via sdv.single_table; evaluate_quality imported from sdv.evaluation.single_table
needs: README is minimal (only setup instructions); repository's overall purpose beyond synthesis wrapper is unclear
